assets.title: Początek drogi
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: a unique full-bleed square watercolor illustration for a Traveler Passport level banner in the Polish camping community app RazemGo. Paint artwork only, never an app screenshot.
Style: warm hand-painted watercolor and gouache, visible fine paper grain, delicate organic brushwork, layered translucent pigment washes, natural proportions, painterly foliage. Sage and pine greens, soft blue distance, muted turquoise, cream sunlight and restrained amber warmth, consistent with charming camping travel illustrations. No glossy 3D, vector icon aesthetic or photographic stock rendering.
Composition: one continuous opaque square painting, generous scenery edge to edge, no border. This square will be used as a wide banner about 340 by 200 logical pixels, so all important subjects must fit the CENTRAL HORIZONTAL BAND between y=28% and y=60%, with generous margins around heads and objects. Keep the strongest subject around x=50–75%; the upper edge and lower quarter can be quiet sky, meadow or foreground. The bottom of the banner gets a light gradient and live native text, so do not put essential faces or props in the very bottom. Keep the scene clearly readable when viewed as a small mobile card. No baked-in text wash or blank white panel.
Constraints: no text, writing, lettering, numbers, logos, watermarks, UI, medals, badges, passport country emblems or typography. Do not print any captions or level names. Natural believable scenery, not a surreal collage.
Scene: The beginning of a woodland adventure: a small well-worn sage-green hiking backpack and a pair of sturdy boots resting beside the first stepping stones of a winding woodland path. A welcoming wooden footbridge and sunlit meadow beyond, young birches, wildflowers, soft distant hills, fresh gentle morning light. Objects modest in scale, grouped in the central-right band, no people, vehicles or tents. A hopeful feeling of setting out for the first time.
